utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, all. Friday the twenty-seventh. Everyone hearing me? Tom's not in today.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Bit of a hum from someone's end.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's probably mine. Office fan's got a bearing like a bag of spanners.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: It's all right, we can hear over it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: More importantly, there's a birthday cake in the office. Proper one, not those individually wrapped things.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And the charity bake sale on Friday is today, so we're absolutely surrounded by cake.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Dangerous place to hold a morning meeting, that office.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'm showing considerable restraint, actually.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Very proud of you. Right, quick round on where we're at, then today's bits. Jamie?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah so, the shift handover report — I've had a first look, nothing major so far. I'm partway through it; it hasn't gone round yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, cheers.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: My function test's stuck. Production won't give us a window, so I can't get on with that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: It's wall-to-wall on the plan at the minute. Not much breathing space anywhere.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Mm. Understood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Tom asked me to say his leak inspection's all done. That's sorted.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Lovely, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Haley asked me to pass on his pre-use checks while his mic was playing up before we started. They're all done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Reidy.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And I'm audible now, hopefully — I've got the downtime for the Atlas agreed with production. Booking's sorted.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, heard every word of that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: One other bit from me: I already swapped the filter on the GT1 compressor yesterday. That's done.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Ah, right. Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Just an observation from earlier: I saw the pressure on the barrel on three dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Back where it normally sits?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, normal reading again. Nobody touched anything. Just mentioning what I saw.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Right, today's work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Haley, can you check the guarding on the Arburg? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll check the guarding on the Arburg straight away.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, physical guarding you're talking about?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, the guarding. Not asking for an electrical test.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Got you. That's my first stop.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah, could you inspect the pop valve for leaks, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll inspect the pop valve for leaks when I've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just a leak inspection, nothing being stripped?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly, just the inspection.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Reidy, can you write up the near miss at Injection Moulding Line 1 first thing tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Tomorrow as in Saturday, yeah? Just checking I've heard that right.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, accepted. I'll write up the near miss at Injection Moulding Line 1 first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, I nearly spoke over you there. Carry on.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: There's also the pressure drop on the line one HPU, Saz. That needs investigating — top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the line one HPU by the end of the week. I'll treat that as top priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Blimey, Friday already. This week's disappeared.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: It has, but yes, by the end of the week is what I'm committing to.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Okay, thanks, Saz.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, that's the main production worry from my side.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, did someone say something then? Teams keeps leaving a gap and then giving me everyone at once.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Only Reidy. You're caught up.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Friday morning internet. Even that's had enough.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, we'll leave it there. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Cheers, all.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: See you in a bit.
